component.name: Autark
component.summary: A small AI company on your own PC

description.p: Autark is a desktop app that runs a small AI company for you: a personal manager as your right hand, teams of agents, chats and tasks, a daily overview with your calendar, a browser beside the chat, your phone, and your other PCs as one.
The agents work through the AI plans you already have, API keys or local model servers. Everything runs on your own PC.
